reason: Fresh-main Release Closure prerequisite for KF-P0-05. Trusted main still declares Electron 39.8.5 across the package/runtime trust graph. Electron 39 reached upstream end-of-life on 2026-05-05, and current upstream security advisory GHSA-9f4c-93c8-jc8g classifies versions below 39.8.10 as affected by a High-severity sandboxed-iframe popup-boundary bypass. The release closure may not ship an EOL runtime with unresolved High advisory exposure. This revision is diagnostic-only: it authorizes one tests-only failure-first path so the complete active Electron dependency, archive trust, workflow, Windows harness and reproducibility source graph can be measured on one immutable exact head before any dependency, workflow, trust metadata or runtime bytes are modified. The reviewed current migration candidate is upstream stable Electron 43.4.1, but this revision grants no dependency or production modification authority; exact production paths and dependency identity require a same-work-package post-RED amendment after the Closure Matrix reaches unknownBlockers=0.
